from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,shutil
def cmd(args,timeout=30):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip(),p.stderr.strip()
def size(p):
 c,o,e=cmd(['du','-x','-s','-B1',p],30)
 return int(o.split()[0]) if c==0 else -1
def state(name):
 c,o,e=cmd(['systemctl','is-active',name+'.service'],8)
 return o
names=['pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-root','nginx','postgresql@16-main','systemd-journald']
before={x:state(x) for x in names}
if any(v!='active' for v in before.values()):
 raise RuntimeError('Baseline service not active; no journal cleanup')
path='/var/log/journal'
pre=size(path)
disk_before=shutil.disk_usage('/').free
print('JOURNAL_BEFORE_BYTES='+str(pre))
rc,o,e=cmd(['journalctl','--rotate','--no-pager'],45)
if rc!=0: raise RuntimeError('journal rotate failed: '+str(rc))
rc,o,e=cmd(['journalctl','--vacuum-size=350M','--no-pager'],80)
print('JOURNAL_VACUUM_EXIT='+str(rc))
print('JOURNAL_VACUUM_SUMMARY='+e[-500:].replace('\n',' | '))
if rc!=0:raise RuntimeError('Journal vacuum failed')
after=size(path)
disk_after=shutil.disk_usage('/').free
print('JOURNAL_AFTER_BYTES='+str(after))
print('JOURNAL_SAVED_BYTES='+str(pre-after))
print('FREE_DISK_GAIN_BYTES='+str(disk_after-disk_before))
final={x:state(x) for x in names}
for k in names:
 print('SERVICE|'+k+'|'+before[k]+'|'+final[k])
if final!=before:raise RuntimeError('Protected service state changed')
print('CLEANUP=PASS')
